# 1827. Minimum Operations to Make the Array Increasing

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def minOperations(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = 0
        cur_num = nums[0]
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            if nums[i] <= cur_num:
                ans += (cur_num - nums[i] + 1)
                cur_num = cur_num + 1
            else:
                cur_num = nums[i]
        return ans
```
